fact: Circular 020/MINFI/DGI/LRI/UEIR of 8 May 2024 sets the obligation of legal persons to file beneficial-owner information in the central register of beneficial owners maintained by the Directorate General of Taxation.
title: Circular N° 020/MINFI/DGI/LRI/UEIR of 08 May 2024 laying down the practical procedures for the implementation of the obligations of legal persons and arrangements in respect of beneficial ownership
publisher: Ministère des Finances, Direction Générale des Impôts
